repair: P120-R1 targeted evidence-integrity repair (Phase-6 blocker in promotion eligibility)

defect.before: _sidecar_sha_ok() returned None when the artifact/sidecar could not be resolved and the caller did NOT refuse (None path); the actual artifact BYTES were never hashed against obs.sha256; price locator quotes were never re-resolved — a crafted/mutated ACCEPTED packet with missing artifact/sidecar, malformed sidecar, byte-substituted artifact, or bogus price quote could pass eligibility (violates contracts E/F).
defect.after: fail-closed evidence triple-check on every cited observation: (1) artifact must resolve AND sidecar must exist and parse — missing/unresolvable artifact, missing sidecar, malformed sidecar => EVIDENCE_TAMPERED; (2) actual artifact bytes SHA-256 == obs.sha256 AND sidecar sha256 == obs.sha256 (byte-hash cached per process); (3) locator required; price locator quote re-resolved against the observation value with the P119-R5 normalisation (comma/space strip, integral float) => mismatch EVIDENCE_TAMPERED. Runner/verifier untouched — this is a guard AROUND the frozen acceptance path.
defect.real_set_impact: all 128 distinct cited artifacts already satisfy file+sidecar+sidecar-sha+byte-sha (verified before implementation) => production dry-run under the stricter guard shows ZERO new refusals: refusals remain ALREADY_PROMOTED 836 / STATUS_NOT_ACCEPTED 71, writes 0

red_before.detail: on HEAD 6088d93: N1 missing artifact, N2 missing sidecar, N4 byte-hash mismatch, N5 price quote mismatch produced NO refusal (set()); N3/N6 refused only with the generic detail string (pins for standardized details); P1 positive already passed
